newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Fianna Fail's Ahern assured of win over Irish govt.
newsitem.headline: Fianna Fail's Ahern assured of win over Irish govt.

text.p: Opposition Fianna Fail (FF) leader Bertie Ahern and his Progressive Democrats (PD) ally were assured of victory in Ireland's election on Sunday when they won a joint 80 seats.
With only three seats remaining to be counted, the FF/PD held 80 seats and Prime Minister John Bruton's government 73, according to official results.
But Ahern will need to win all three remaining seats to control the 166-seat parliament and is almost certain to need the support of Independent parties to govern, analysts said.
Ahern said earlier that he was almost certain to form the next government when parliament returns on June 23.
Bruton virtually acknowledged defeat when he said it appeared that Fianna Fail and its right-wing ally looked like securing a majority in parliament.
